workflow_route: Local Blender modeling/assembly/rendering, direct-file delivery per Lux3D references/results.md
acceptance_boundary: The actual bundled Lux3D artifact inspector checked the final GLB container and embedded asset structure.
These structural checks alone do not certify composition, native Blender fidelity or web interactions; see the independent Blender validation and five actual renders.
This is a purely local Blender scene. No cloud task IDs, generation state or Lux3D bundle manifest were fabricated. Verified Blender files, GLB and static renders are delivered directly.
The GLB uses the existing verified web lion LOD and approximates procedural environment materials. The .blend retains native curve data and materials.
